name: skill-layout-agents-claude-symlink
description: Project skills live in .agents/skills with a relative symlink in .claude/skills; no .pi/skills or .bb/skills copy
metadata:

  type: feedback

  modified: 2026-10-12T13:57:52.038Z
---

The user wants repo skills written once in `.agents/skills/<name>/` and exposed to Claude Code by a relative symlink `.claude/skills/<name> -> ../../.agents/skills/<name>`. Do not add `.pi/skills` (pi already reads `.agents/skills`, and a second copy makes pi warn about a name collision) or `.bb/skills` (bb injects it for every provider, so it duplicates what each provider loads natively).

**Why:** they run bb with the claude-code provider and pi. Tested 2026-10-12: Claude Code loads the symlinked skill (`claude -p` listed it), and pi gets it from `.agents/skills`. `bb skill list` shows it as provider-project/pi but skips any symlinked dir in `.claude/skills` for claude-code, so bb's catalog under-reports it.

**How to apply:** when creating a repo skill (e.g. the verify skill, [[verify-chauvenity-os-skill]]), use this layout. Keep helper scripts resolving the repo root from `realpath "$0"` so calling them through either path works.

set -e; OLD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo $OLD
git branch backup/simplify-readme-land-skill $OLD
# README-only branch (reuse PR 117)
git reset -q --hard origin/main
git checkout $OLD -- README.md
git commit -q -m "docs: simplify README"
# land skill branch
git switch -q -c docs/land-skill origin/main
git checkout $OLD -- .agents/skills/land/SKILL.md
ln -s ../../.agents/skills/land .claude/skills/land
git add .agents/skills/land .claude/skills/land
git commit -q -m "docs: add land skill"
